Apartament 2+1 ne Shitje tek Shkolla e Baletit
Shitet apartament 2+1 tek Shkolla e Baletit, Rruga Mihal Grameno.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 9 (te fundit) te nje pallati te ri te mireadministruar me ashensor ne nje zone qe ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme dhe shume prane qendres se qytetit.
Organizohet nga sonxhorno bashke me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi dhe tualeti.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me shume info ose vizite ne prone na kontaktoni;
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at the Ballet School
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at the Ballet School 2+1 apartment for sale at the Ballet School, Mihal Grameno Street. The apartment is located on the 9th (top) floor of a new well-managed building with an elevator in an area that offers all the necessary facilities and very close to the city center. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms and a bathroom. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us;
